section_summary.extract_value: This procedures section describes a study where college students completed a paper-and-pencil questionnaire on campus in a group setting after providing informed consent. Participants were recruited from a college participant pool and elected to participate for course credit in foundational psychology courses. The study examined attitudes and behaviors related to body modification, body image, risk behaviors, and mental health, with measures presented in the same order for all participants.
